Speech recognition depends on device support and may use a network service. Reports are not insurer-certified valuations. This listing is a draft and must not be published before release validation.

support:title: Possessory support
support:getting_started: Create a household, choose its currency and add rooms. Add a belonging with its purchase details and optional warranty expiry date. No account is required.
support:where_is_my_data: Inventory records and attachments are stored in the app’s private storage on this device. Nothing is silently synchronised. Uninstalling removes local data, so save and verify a backup first.
support:receipts: Open a belonging and attach a receipt image or PDF. Use Review and extract receipt to rotate or trim the review image and run English text extraction on your device. Check every suggestion before applying it. The complete original attachment is retained; PDF extraction uses the first page.
support:backup: In Settings, save a ZIP backup with metadata and attachments. Optionally choose password protection and use at least twelve characters. Keep the password securely: it cannot be recovered. The restore size limit is 100 MiB decompressed; individual attachment imports are limited to 25 MiB.
support:restore: Open a backup in Settings, enter its password if encrypted and inspect the import preview. Possessory checks the schema, attachment hashes and record references. Existing record IDs are retained and only new records are merged. Verify your belongings and attachments after restoring.
support:reminders: Enable optional reminders in Settings and allow notifications when prompted. Possessory checks upcoming warranty dates and scheduled maintenance approximately daily. Device power management can delay notifications. Reminders do not replace professional safety inspections.
support:voice: Use the microphone shortcut, review the recognised words and open the requested screen. Supported English commands include Find my laptop, Show items in the kitchen, Add a new item and Show my inventory summary. Type a command if the device has no recognition service. Speech recognition may use your device provider’s network service.
support:reports: Choose a room, record filter and output format. Review serial-number and recorded-value settings before saving. The on-screen preview shows the first six matching records. Reports are user-maintained inventory records and are not insurer-certified valuations.
support:premium: Amazon purchases are unavailable until the product and verification service are configured. A verified Premium purchase removes the new-item and household limits. Purchase identifiers are checked with the configured receipt-verification service. Offline signed access lasts up to 90 days before it needs refreshing. Your existing records and deletion tools remain accessible without Premium.
support:warranties: Warranty dates and terms are supplied by you. Manufacturer warranties and statutory consumer rights are separate. Possessory does not determine eligibility or provide definitive legal advice.
support:delete: Delete a belonging from its detail screen to remove its record, attachments and maintenance entries. To remove every local record and setting, use Delete all local data in Settings and confirm. Files you exported elsewhere are not deleted.
support:draft_notice: Engineering preview support draft. Device-specific validation and translation review are pending.
